definition: Integer link per seam, zero at the start. Every applied twist adds its integer current j, with |j| at most 3.
Face value m = sum of the links the face traverses a to b minus the sum of those it traverses b to a.
Class = m modulo 6. A defect face has a nonzero class. A flat face has class 0 and can hold a multiple of 6.

source.note: no measured value enters; the hypercharge integers are 6Y = 3 n2 - 2 n3 on the 32 patterns of the code

statements.label: DECLARED
statements.text: The Z6 register of the runs is a declared layer on the exact loads. The integer lift keeps the unreduced current j of every applied twist on the link of its seam. A face value m is the signed sum of the links around the face. The class is m modulo 6.

statements.label: EXACT
statements.text: The value modulo 6 equals the stored class of every face on every stored cut at levels 4, 5 and 6, and on the screen at level 7: 447,750,768 face comparisons, no mismatch. At level 7 the end state equals the stored checkpoint on all 6,717,442 faces.

statements.label: EXACT
statements.text: Stokes: the twenty face values of a carrier sum to zero, on 68,515,840 carrier states with no exception. The plaquette values of the screen sum to zero on every cut. The integer word of a carrier has total 0. The word (+4,-2,-2) occurs. The word (+4,+4,-2) occurs only with -6 on a flat face of the same carrier.

statements.label: EXACT
statements.text: The law reads the class only. Two faces of equal class and different value have the same future. The value is a record of the path of the applied current, and no step of the run depends on it.

statements.label: EXACT
statements.text: A pair birth on two faces of value 0 gives (j,-j). A face of absolute value 4 or more does not move with its value: when it empties it keeps a nonzero multiple of 6. In the band every current is 1 or -1, and a defect of value +1 or -1 moves intact across faces of value 0.

statements.label: MEASURED
statements.text: End of level 6, carrier faces: class 4 holds -2 on 91.7 percent and +4 on 8.0 percent of its faces. Class 2 holds +2 on 91.7 and -4 on 8.1 percent. Class 3 holds +3 on 3,360 and -3 on 3,274 faces. 92.9 percent of the defect faces take the value of least absolute size.

statements.label: MEASURED
statements.text: 99.67 percent of the defect faces at the end of level 6 hold a value that is 6Y of a Standard Model multiplet (level 5: 99.76, level 7: 99.67). 169 faces hold another value: 8, 9 or 10 in absolute size, and a few 5 and 7. During the run the share of 5 peaks at 1.05 percent of the defect faces at depth 192.

statements.label: MEASURED
statements.text: Flat faces hold +6 or -6: 16,454 carrier faces at the end of level 6, 1.04 percent of the flat faces. The register cannot see them. Most of them are left behind when a defect of value 5 or 7 moves on.

statements.label: MEASURED
statements.text: Carriers of composition {4,4,4} at the end of level 7 (1,325 carriers): the word (+4,-2,-2) on 53.4 percent, the word (-2,-2,-2) with +6 on a flat face on 24.2 percent, other words on 22.4 percent. Level 6: 57.2, 21.0 and 21.9 percent.

statements.label: MEASURED
statements.text: Null model: the same twists with a random representative of each class leave 63.0 percent of the defect faces at a hypercharge integer and 32.1 percent at the least value. The run has 99.7 and 92.9 percent. The free sum of all currents agrees with the class on one face in six, which is chance.

statements.label: ARGUED
statements.text: Reading as hypercharge: m = 6Y. A class-4 face of value +4 is then the flux that u_R sees, and a face of value -2 the flux that d_R sees. A pure flux content is a boson. The word (+4,-2,-2) is the flux that a u d d content sees. It is not a neutron.

statements.label: ARGUED
statements.text: The lift separates u_R from d_R. It does not separate u_L from d_L, both have 6Y = +1. It does not separate the lepton doublet from the Higgs doublet. T3 stays outside it.

statements.label: ARGUED
statements.text: Verdict on the reading. As a statement about the set of values it holds on 99.7 percent of the defect faces and fails as an exact law. A value of size 4 or more does not travel with its defect, the register never reads it, and one composition carries several words. The lift records how often the applied current wound around the face. It is no member label.

statements.label: MEASURED
statements.text: Class-3 pair check on the stored loads of level 6. In the band no face holds a double load on one port: the share is exactly 0 for every class. The three loads have equal parity on 25.75 percent of the resting class-3 faces and on 25.75 percent of the flat faces. Before the band, resting class-3 faces hold a double on 1.13 percent, flat faces on 1.36 percent, moving class-3 faces on 2.24 percent.
